Translation: to send rain, to rain, to wet
a biting, a gnashing of teeth
to grant, dispose of by a will
easy; only comparative in the NT
to pelt with stones, to stone
to make war, hence to serve as a soldier
to break apart, throw down, dash
to be clearly seen, to be fitting, proper
from what country? what kind of?
a votive offering, that which is accursed
to lay upon, lay down, to lie back
to puff or blow up, be arrogant
to muzzle, to put to silence
